item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor las zlog pa 'byung ba'i stobs ldan
item.coloph: ces gsang ba 'dus pa sgrab pa'i las tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas/ nang sgrab gab pa dgu skor zlog pa 'byung ba'i stobs ldan zhes pa 'di yang / dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol sa gsum las 'gran zla bral ba'i grub dbang bstan 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin grags pa'i gser khrir skyong ba'i 7spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags kyis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ ma zad mkhas pa'i nor la dbang ba'i drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang / rigs mthun drang srong dbang 'dus gnyis nas yang yang du bskul ba la brten nas/ deng gi gdag byar du gyur pa rgya bon gyi rigs rus nges par gtogs pa'i 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ dus dang skabs la bab par dran nas g.yung drung bon gyi 'dus gnas chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du snang tshad grogs su 'char ba'i thun mtshams la dkar chag yi ger phab pa'o//
